clips.title: The story
paras: Along Darkshore's coast, Gwennyth Bly'Leggonde watches the tides and the remains washing ashore. The night elf lives in Auberdine and sends travelers to examine strange sea creatures and massive turtles found dead on the northern beaches.

Gwennyth Bly'Leggonde keeps watch over the coast from her home in Auberdine. While others in town tend to the forest or shipping across the Veiled Sea, she follows the shoreline. Lately, the tides have carried the remains of huge sea creatures onto the sands. She asks travelers to search the beaches, bring back skeletal samples, and learn what is happening in the waters offshore.

North and south of Auberdine, more sea creatures and ancient sea turtles are washing ashore. Gwennyth asks travelers to inspect the bodies and bones. She hopes to learn what drove the creatures onto the beaches or killed them, and to understand the danger in the waters off northern Kalimdor.
